common.notPregnantTitle: This tool works in pregnancy mode
common.notPregnantBody: To use it, first add your pregnancy and its dates in Ritme.

kick.title: Kick counter
kick.lead: Lie on your left side and tap the button for every movement (kick, roll, flutter).
kick.guidance: If you feel fewer than {target} movements in {hours}, or the pattern slows down, call your doctor or midwife.
kick.reachedBody: You reached the target. You can finish and save the count.
kick.lowBody: This alone is not a diagnosis, but it is worth talking to your doctor or midwife today. If you can't feel the baby move at all, don't wait.
kick.historyEmpty: No saved counts yet. Each count you finish shows up here.
kick.helpBody: Pick a time when your baby is usually active, for example after a meal. Lie on your side and tap once for each kick, roll or flutter. Most people feel 10 movements well within 2 hours. What matters more than the number is a change in your baby's usual pattern.
kick.helpNote: This tool does not replace a check-up.

contraction.title: Contraction timer
contraction.staleBody: This timing has been open since {time}. Tap “Stop and save” to close it, then start a new one.
contraction.empty: No contractions yet. Tap the button when one starts and again when it ends.
contraction.guidance: If contractions come every {interval} minutes, each lasting about 1 minute, for {run}, or your waters break, call your maternity unit.
contraction.metTitle: Your contractions reached the call-the-unit pattern
contraction.metBody: This is worked out from the times you logged, and only an exam can confirm that labour has started. It is time to call your maternity unit or midwife.
contraction.helpTitle: How does the contraction timer work?
contraction.helpBody: Tap the button when a contraction starts and again when it ends. The length, the time since the previous one started and the averages over the last hour are worked out for you.
contraction.helpNote: If you are bleeding, have constant pain or the baby moves less, don't wait for the pattern — call.
